title: New exploratory NAAMP site-history vs local context and checkerboard analysis
authorized_by: Explicit user question on 2026-10-20: new analyses; historical site reuse independent of environmental conditions? checkerboard result?
authority: Separate exploratory analysis. RC6 science lock and existing JAE submission artifact unchanged.
source: ScienceBase NAAMP item 583dc314e4b0d1899f9dea8d, Runs/Stops/Counts pinned SHA256 via scripts/naamp/run_naamp_ecological_pulse.py

history.population: Existing adjacent-year matched wetter–drier NAAMP comparisons; physically stable complete ten-stop SiteIDs; focal taxa acoustically route-new in wetter run but found on earlier route-runs; historical data strictly earlier than both focal years.
history.exposure: prior CI>=2 at same species×physical SiteID
history.unit: species × pair × wet-stop; fixed effects species×pair
history.model0: previously published fixed-effect linear probability model, re-estimated on exactly the eligible complete-case adjusted-model rows
history.model1: model0 plus within-survey stop air-temperature (C), other species' same-stop CI>=2 count (target taxon excluded), number of other taxa with strictly-prior CI>=2 at that physical SiteID, and linear/quadratic standardized StopNumber
history.inference: route-clustered sandwich SE; exact same rows in unadjusted and adjusted model; no interpretation as causal memory or independence from unmeasured hydrology.
history.decision: Historical-site effect survives measured local context only if adjusted beta>0 and lower 95% route-clustered bound>0, n>=350 species-pair groups, n>=200 routes. Otherwise unresolved/not supported.

checkerboard.question: Do active taxa at the ten wetland-associated stops segregate beyond what species' detected-stop totals and each stop's total taxon richness predict?
checkerboard.statistic: Stone–Roberts C-score, mean over unordered observed taxon pairs: (r_i-s_ij)(r_j-s_ij), where r_i detected stop count and s_ij shared detected stops
checkerboard.population: Eligible unified-protocol NAAMP route runs entering matched sample, 10 sampled stops, >=3 acoustically positive taxa; runs with no varying possible margins retained as zero information but flagged.
checkerboard.null: Curveball random fixed-row/column-sum bipartite binary incidence matrices; 99 Monte Carlo draws, burn-in >=max(80,30 × active_taxa) trades, thinning >=max(20,8 × active_taxa) trades; seed=20261020
checkerboard.primary: run-level C-score minus its fixed-marginal null mean; report mean residual (route-clustered CI) over unique eligible runs
checkerboard.secondary: for matched wetter/drier pairs where both have checkerboard estimates, wet-minus-dry residual; route-clustered CI and model controlling rain contrast, temp/doy differences, year gap, State and RunNumber; false positive significance from many related routes avoided by route clustering
checkerboard.decision: Checkerboard supported only if primary residual >0 with two-sided route-clustered 95% CI excluding zero; wetter-associated enhancement supported only if paired wet−dry difference>0 with 95% CI excluding zero.
boundaries: Checkerboard segregation cannot establish biological competition, avoidance or stable exclusive habitat.
Within-taxon multi-stop clustering is mathematically different from between-taxon checkerboard segregation.
Observed acoustic detections are not occupancy or movement.
All tests are exploratory on previously inspected NAAMP data, not independent replication; local hydrology is not directly measured.
checkerboard.additional_predeclared_secondary: Repeat conditional C-score for CallingIndex>=2 strong choruses, 99 Monte Carlo draws and the same eligibility, to distinguish faint presence from strong acoustic activity. Compare the two descriptive patterns without choosing a new primary based on outcomes.
